When you encounter these obstacles or questions on the path, first meet yourself with deep patience and warmth. The natural habit of the conditioned ego is to panic, resist, or frantically search for a technique to control present reality. But the Dhamma invites you to take a gentle step backward—to stop fighting the current moment and instead observe the unfolding process with calm, non-judgmental clarity.

So when I say your true nature is love, you don't have to look for it."* From the foundational perspective of the Four Noble Truths, suffering (*dukkha*) is never caused by the mere presence of sensations, thoughts, or external conditions.
